name: list_local_apis
title: List the APIs in Studio
description: Lists the APIs in this Spec0 Studio library: specs the user opened from files, URLs or Spec0, including ones that aren't published anywhere. For each: id, title, version, where it came from, number of operations, base URLs from the spec's servers, and whether it has a hosted mock. Use the id or title with the other tools. To search every API in the user's organisation, use the remote Spec0 MCP server instead.

name: get_api_spec
title: Get an API's OpenAPI document
description: Returns the OpenAPI document Studio holds for one API, exactly as stored (YAML or JSON). Large documents come back in parts: the first part says how many characters there are and which offset to ask for next. For one endpoint, get_operation is usually enough and much smaller.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

offset.description: Character offset to start from, for the next part of a large document. Default 0.

name: get_operation
title: Get one operation
description: Returns one operation of an API: parameters, request body schema, responses, the security schemes it uses, and the full URL for each server (and for the hosted mock, if there is one). Identify it by operation_id, or by method and path. To call it, use send_request, or call the URL yourself.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

method.description: HTTP method, such as GET. Use with path.

path.description: Path as written in the spec, such as /orders/{orderId}. Use with method.

name: search_operations
title: Search operations
description: Fuzzy search over the operations of the APIs in Studio (paths, operationIds, summaries, tags and descriptions). Returns the best matches with their API, method and path; pass one to get_operation for details. Searches this machine's library only; for the whole organisation, use the remote Spec0 MCP server.

query.description: What you're looking for, such as "cancel order" or "/users/{id}".

api.description: Limit the search to one API (id or title). Optional.

limit.description: How many results to return. Default 15.

name: get_connection_status
title: Get Studio's connection status
description: Says whether Studio is signed in to Spec0 or working locally, the organisation name, the Spec0 app URL, the address of the remote Spec0 MCP server, and the Studio and MCP server versions. Call this first to know whether the signed-in tools (mock servers) will work.

name: list_environments
title: List environments and variables
description: Lists the user's Studio environments (named sets of variables used as {{name}} in requests), which one is active, and each variable's name. Values are included for ordinary variables only. Secret variables are listed by name and marked secret; their values are never shared. If you need one, ask the user.

name: get_mock_server
title: Get an API's hosted mock server
description: Requires the user to be signed in to Spec0 in Studio. For one API: the hosted mock's base URL, its API key (if Studio has it), the header to send it in, the spec version the mock was built from, and a curl command you can run.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

name: create_mock_server
title: Create a hosted mock server
description: Requires the user to be signed in to Spec0 in Studio. Creates a hosted mock server for an API that is already published to Spec0, and returns its URL and API key. If the API already has a mock, that one is returned. An API that exists only on this machine has to be published from Studio first.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

name: refresh_mock_server
title: Rebuild a mock from the latest spec
description: Requires the user to be signed in to Spec0 in Studio. Rebuilds an API's hosted mock from the latest version published to Spec0. The mock keeps its URL and API key.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

name: send_request
title: Send a request
description: Sends one request for an operation through Studio, with the user's environments, proxy and certificate settings, and returns the status, headers, body and whether the response matches the spec. Refer to values as {{name}} from the active environment; Studio fills them in, and secret values never appear in what comes back. The user approves each host in Studio the first time (and DELETE, PUT and PATCH to hosts outside this computer separately), so this can wait for them. For a URL that isn't in any spec, pass method and url instead of api.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

method.description: HTTP method, such as POST. Use with path.

path.description: Path as written in the spec, such as /orders/{orderId}. Use with method.

url.description: A full URL, for a request that isn't in any spec. Use with method, without api.

target.description: Where to send: "server" (the spec's first server), "mock" (the hosted mock), "local-mock" (the API's local mock, which must be running), or a base URL such as http://localhost:8080. Defaults to the spec's first server.

path_params.description: Values for {path} parameters, by name. Values can use {{variable}} from the active environment.

headers.description: Extra headers, by name. Use {{variable}} for credentials; Studio fills them in and never returns the values.

body.description: The request body: a JSON value, or a string for other content types. Strings inside it can use {{variable}}.

auth_value.description: The value for the operation's security scheme, usually a {{variable}}. Without it, an OAuth 2 scheme uses the token Studio holds for this API, if any.

name: check_contract
title: Check a running server against the spec
description: Sends a request for each operation of an API to a base URL (for example http://localhost:8080) and reports, for each one, the status and whether the response matches the spec. Path and required parameters come from the active environment by name; operations without values are skipped and say why. Only GET, HEAD and OPTIONS run unless include_mutating is true. The user approves the host in Studio first.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

target.description: Where to send: "server" (the spec's first server), "mock" (the hosted mock), "local-mock" (the API's local mock, which must be running), or a base URL such as http://localhost:8080. Defaults to the spec's first server.

operations.description: Only these operations, as operationIds or "METHOD /path". Defaults to all.

include_mutating.description: Also run POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE operations. Off by default.

name: list_local_mocks
title: List running local mocks
description: Lists the local mocks running in Studio: which API each serves and its address on this computer.

name: start_local_mock
title: Start a local mock
description: Starts a local mock of an API on this computer (127.0.0.1) and returns its address. It answers with examples from the spec, and runs until it is stopped or Studio quits.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

name: stop_local_mock
title: Stop a local mock
description: Stops the local mock of an API that is running in Studio. Requests to its address fail after that.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

name: list_collections
title: List collections
description: Lists the collections in Studio: name, id, number of steps, whether it is a draft made by an agent, the file it is saved to, and its last run.

name: get_collection
title: Get a collection
description: Returns a collection's steps in order: each step's key, operation, target, parameters, headers, body, expected status, and the values it takes from earlier steps.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

name: create_collection
title: Create a collection
description: Creates a draft collection in Studio, empty or as a copy of another. The user sees it as it is built and can keep or discard it. Agents can change only the drafts they create.

copy_of.description: A collection to copy, by id or name.

name: add_step
title: Add a step
description: Adds an operation as a step at the end of a draft collection (or at position). Parameters not given start from the spec's examples. Returns the step's key, which later steps use to refer to its response.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

method.description: HTTP method, such as POST. Use with path.

path.description: Path as written in the spec, such as /orders/{orderId}. Use with method.

key.description: A key for the step. Defaults to the operationId.

name.description: A name to show for the step.

target.description: Where to send: "server" (the spec's first server), "mock" (the hosted mock), "local-mock" (the API's local mock, which must be running), or a base URL such as http://localhost:8080. Defaults to the spec's first server.

path_params.description: Values for {path} parameters, by name. Values can use {{variable}} from the active environment.

headers.description: Extra headers, by name. Use {{variable}} for credentials; Studio fills them in and never returns the values.

body.description: The request body: a JSON value, or a string for other content types. Strings inside it can use {{variable}}.

expect_status.description: The status the step expects: "201", "4XX". Defaults to any 2xx.

position.description: Where to put it, from 0. Defaults to the end.

name: update_step
title: Change a step
description: Changes a step in a draft collection. Parameters and headers given are merged in (a null value removes one); a body given replaces the old one.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

target.description: Where to send: "server" (the spec's first server), "mock" (the hosted mock), "local-mock" (the API's local mock, which must be running), or a base URL such as http://localhost:8080. Defaults to the spec's first server.

path_params.description: Path parameter values to set, by name; null removes one.

query.description: Query parameters to set, by name; null removes one.

headers.description: Headers to set, by name; null removes one.

body.description: The request body: a JSON value, or a string for other content types. Strings inside it can use {{variable}}.

name: remove_step
title: Remove a step
description: Removes a step from a draft collection. Later steps that used its response are listed in the result.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

name: link_value
title: Use a value from an earlier step
description: Fills a field of a step with a value from an earlier step's response, for example the new order's id in the next step's path. Written as a {{steps.<key>.<path>}} reference in the step.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

step.description: The key of the step whose field is filled.

field.description: The field to fill: path.<name>, query.<name>, header.<name>, or body.<path> such as body.items[0].sku.

from_step.description: The key of the earlier step.

from.description: Where in its response: body.<path> such as body.id, headers.<name>, or status.

name: set_expected_status
title: Set a step's expected status
description: Sets the status a step expects, such as "404" or "4XX". A step passes when the status matches and the response matches what the spec declares for that status. "2XX" is the default.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

name: run_collection
title: Run a collection
description: Runs a collection's steps in order through Studio and waits for the result: each step's status, whether it passed, and why not. Values pass between steps and secret values never appear in the result. The run shows in Studio's Runs view, and the user approves the hosts it calls. Use get_run_log for the full log.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

target.description: Send every step that uses a spec here instead of its own target: "server", "mock", "local-mock" or a base URL.

name: get_run_log
title: Get a run's log
description: Returns the log of a collection run, the latest by default: each step's request, response, schema check, values passed between steps and why it failed. Secret values are replaced by their {{name}}.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

run_id.description: A run id from run_collection. Defaults to the latest run.

name: save_collection_to_folder
title: Save a collection to a file
description: Saves a collection as a .spec0-collection.yaml file, for example in the project's repository, so it can be reviewed and run again. The user approves the path in Studio first. Saving keeps a draft. Secret values are written as {{references}}.

collection.description: The collection's id or name, from list_collections.

path.description: Absolute path of the file. The .spec0-collection.yaml ending is added if missing.

name: reload_spec
title: Reload a spec
description: Reads an API's spec again from its file or URL, after it has been changed, and reports what changed: version, operations and schemas added, removed or changed, and servers.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.

name: validate_spec
title: Check a spec for problems
description: Reports problems in an API's spec that stop it from loading or make operations hard to use: references that don't resolve, path parameters that aren't declared, duplicate operationIds, operations without responses, and missing servers.

api.description: The API's id or title, from list_local_apis.
